title: Zesty Crunchy Ukrainian Citrus Stir-fry
description: A citrusy, crunchy post-workout dish featuring vegetable stock and pressure-cooked elements for a paleo-friendly meal.

ingredients.name: Coconut Aminos (as a substitute for soy sauce)

instructions: Prepare all vegetables and seasonings. Heat oil in a pressure cooker.
Add lemon zest and garlic to the cooker, stir-fry for about 2 minutes.
Add celery, carrots, and coconut aminos. Stir well to combine.
Gradually add lime juice while stirring until fully combined, cooking for an additional minute.
Season with wheat-free seasoning blend, mix thoroughly.
Transfer the mixture into serving bowls, garnish with chopped almonds.
Serve hot as a snack or meal.
